changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant task names ('Restoration' → 'Text Restoration'), normalized model names to standard forms, removed verbose output descriptions, and added chronological dating as an output type since it's evaluated alongside restoration.
Consolidated metric variants into base forms (e.g., Exact@1/5/10 → Exact@K) following normalization guidelines.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper; the paper focuses on traditional automatic metrics and does not use LLMs for post-generation assessment.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper; evaluation is entirely based on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on ancient Chinese bronze inscription restoration and dating using NLP methods. It evaluates character restoration (NLG task) and chronological classification using automatic metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and consolidation of metric variants. The paper does not use LLM-as-judge or human evaluation methods.
